name: National Government Datacenter / Governmental CIRT facility
developer: Government of Saint Lucia / Caribbean Digital Transformation Project (CARDTP)
notes: Official OPM release says a site has been selected and design plans are being finalized for the National Government Datacenter; 2023 consultancy covers specifications/procurement support for a scalable modular/containerized government datacenter and NOC; 2025/2026 budget references a government data centre. Public sources do not disclose the exact site address; assigned to Castries because government source contact/location and existing GOSL ICT concentration are in Castries.

name: Government Information Technology Services (GITS) datacenter/server room
developer: Government Information Technology Services Ltd. / Government of Saint Lucia
notes: Government TOR appendix lists existing GOSL datacenter/server rooms, including Government Information Technology Services Ltd. in Castries with more than 100 physical servers; same TOR says the future NOC should monitor the CDC and all GOSL datacenter/server rooms.

name: Digicel Business St. Lucia colocation data-centre service
notes: Digicel Business St. Lucia product pages advertise audited colocation facilities with rack/cabinet space, physical security, backup power and cooling. Public page does not disclose the facility address or division; retained for Saint Lucia market coverage and assigned to Castries with low confidence because no parish-level site was found.

name: Liberty Business St. Lucia Cloud & Data Centre / colocation services
notes: Liberty Business St. Lucia page advertises Cloud & Data Centre products, including self-managed private cloud in state-of-the-art data centres across the Caribbean and colocation. It does not identify a specific Saint Lucia facility or division; included as a country-level data-centre/colocation offering with low confidence and assigned to Castries only for batch coverage.

name: Customs Department Vieux Fort server room
developer: Customs and Excise Department / Government of Saint Lucia
notes: Government TOR appendix lists existing GOSL datacenter/server rooms, including Customs Department - Vieux Fort with fewer than 10 physical servers. This is a small government server-room entry rather than a hyperscale/colocation project.
